games.title: Bantay Kubo
games.description: Drive a jeepney tank, fire garlic, and guard the bahay kubo from an army of duwende, tikbalang, aswang and kapre across five barangays.

games.title: Ahas sa Fiesta
games.tagline: Classic snake at a Pinoy fiesta
games.description: A flag-colored snake in a salakot eats street food on a woven banig and dodges the tinikling poles, through seven festival barangays.

games.title: Huling Byahe
games.tagline: The last jeepney of the night
games.description: Drive the last trip through Manila from 11 PM to 5 AM. Your passengers are ghosts, and each one has somewhere to be before sunrise.

games.title: Isang Tira
games.description: Ten Sungka boards, one turn each. Find the perfect sowing that a solver proved is possible. An early playtest of a daily puzzle.
